case_study_packaging.headline: Home-health provider unlocks $534K in annual savings in under six months through Treya-led strategic sourcing
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Choice Health at Home had expanded rapidly across Texas, Oklahoma, Kansas and Louisiana, yet purchasing remained decentralized and lacked enterprise-wide leverage. With approximately $17 million in unmanaged spend and private-equity partners Trive Capital and Coltala Holdings pushing for margin improvement, the leadership team needed immediate, scalable cost reductions. They turned to Treya Partners to aggregate demand, negotiate with key suppliers and capture savings within a six-month value-creation window.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A multi-state home health and hospice provider had expanded rapidly across several southern states, yet purchasing remained decentralized and lacked enterprise-wide leverage. With approximately $17 million in unmanaged spend and the private equity ownership group focusing on operational efficiency and margin improvement, the leadership team needed immediate, scalable cost reductions. They turned to Treya Partners to aggregate demand, negotiate with key suppliers and capture savings within a six-month value-creation window.
approach_summary: Analyzed $39 million in accounts-payable data and cleansed 12 target categories representing $15.1 million in addressable spend to build a fact-based baseline.
Ran a full-market RFP and renegotiated the McKesson distribution agreement, securing 21-22 % price reductions and a standardized clinical formulary for medical supplies.
Restructured the Enterprise fleet maintenance program by mileage tier and negotiated an addendum delivering 4 % annual savings with zero service disruption.
Launched data-driven rate benchmarking and multi-vendor negotiations for therapist and nurse staffing, targeting 4-8 % reductions across seven regional suppliers.
Benchmarked GPO options for office supplies, initiating competitive quotes expected to cut costs 10-15 % while streamlining ordering for branch locations.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya has already locked in $276 K in annual run-rate savings and surfaced another $258 K moving through final contracting, putting the engagement on track for $534 K in recurring benefit—more than double the project’s $250 K fee. Beyond hard dollars, the team delivered standardized medical-supply formularies, improved spend visibility and a repeatable supplier-data collection process that positions the client for ongoing procurement excellence.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered first contracted savings in just 150 days from project kickoff, meeting the PE sponsor’s aggressive timeline.
Balanced clinical preferences with cost goals—keeping McKesson as the primary distributor while cutting pricing by over 20 %.
Combined clinical, labor and indirect categories in a single, coordinated workstream, maximizing leverage across disparate spend areas.
Hands-on supplier outreach and data cleansing overcame limited internal visibility, enabling fact-based negotiations and quick decision making.
